verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a fair axis, but the evidence shows no documented way for users to define rules or hooks that fire actions on events. The closest items do not qualify: automatic snapshots on update are fixed built-in behavior, crash notifications need a manual click to involve the agent, and reminders are one-off countdown timers rather than event rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
